description: Defines the StillnessDetector class used for analyzing pose streams to determine if the subject is still. Includes configuration options, input handling, and internal state management.

classes.name: StillnessDetector
classes.description: A class that processes a stream of pose data to determine if the subject remains still over a specified window.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears the internal window of pose samples.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Adds a new pose sample with a timestamp to the detector.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Determines if the pose stream is still at the given timestamp.

methods.name: getPreviousState
methods.description: Returns the stillness state from the last calculation.
